csv_project_name: Consultant for STA Lake Township Economic Development Study
csv_scope_of_work: The Stark County Area Transportation Study (SCATS), through the Stark County Regional Planning Commission (SCRPC), is issuing a request for letters of interest for a comprehensive study focused on economic development and active transportation to guide growth and investment over the next 10 to 20 years for Lake Township and the Village of Hartville. The study will evaluate land use, transportation, and economic conditions to develop a coordinated strategy that supports business growth, improves connectivity, and enhances quality of life.
